svg.title: hanbit_mart floor plan
svg.text: hanbit_mart · Hanbit Mart, Hapjeong store (+ hanbit_mart_breakroom, hanbit_mart_stockroom, mart_street)
Ground-floor plan in metres, north up. Hapjeong-dong, Mapo-gu: north-east corner of a junction of two residential streets (fictional shop, no real address).
Shop 6.00 × 9.00 m, ceiling 2.8 m. Redrawn to match the Codex keys world/keys/hanbit_mart/, hanbit_mart_ext/ and hanbit_breakroom/.
